text:
mia_cs: Heads up — customer 'HelioPay' is rolling a compliance pilot across EU and APAC. Their proxy rewrites client IPs and is causing our EU edge to reject requests. They need a short-lived header-based exception + a modest rate increase for demo hours.
devin_ops: what headers can their proxy send? IP-based allowlists won't work if the proxy NATs everything.
mia_cs: they can add X-Forwarded-Client and X-Proxy-ID. Security only allows header signals, not IP changes. Pilot is Wed/Thu next week.
arnaud_net: we can create a header-exempt route on eu-edge and map the X-Proxy-ID to a customer tag. Need security signoff and an audit log sink.
kaya_sec: header exemptions are allowed with conditions: 1) cert or signed attestation from their proxy vendor, 2) timeboxed rule (max 96h), 3) full request logging to secure S3.
mia_cs: customer agrees to sign and will upload attestation. They also requested a 500 qps bump during demo hours (two 4-hour windows).
devin_ops: quick checklist: a) create SRE change ticket, b) config: header whitelist + regex for X-Proxy-ID, c) account qps override during windows, d) enable high-detail logs to s3://redwood-sec-logs/heliopay/pilot/, e) schedule auto-revoke.
ops-bot: Created change CHG-2026-9901 assigned to devin_ops. Change window Wed 01:30-03:00 UTC. Please add approval from kaya_sec.
kaya_sec: conditional approval provided customer uploads signed attestation and we get CN from their cert for regex.
devin_ops: added canary 3% for 10m, regex on X-Proxy-ID = ^hp-proxy-[0-9a-f]{6}$, ttl 345600 (96h), qps.override = 500.
mia_cs: shared these with HelioPay. They confirmed attestation will be uploaded tonight and provided an example header block:
```
X-Forwarded-Client: 198.51.100.22
X-Proxy-ID: hp-proxy-3fa2b1
X-Client-Cert-Fingerprint: SHA256:ABCDEF...
```
arnaud_net: prepping config snippet. Will include canary and strict header match.
ops-bot: CHG-2026-9901 updated: canary enabled, header regex set, log target configured.
devin_ops: executing canary now at 01:42 UTC. Monitoring latency and 4xx/5xx rates.
ops-bot: Canary: 3% traffic routed. No 5xx in first 12 minutes, latency stable.
devin_ops: promoting rollout. QPS override active for Wed/Thu demo windows. Auto-revoke scheduled at end of TTL.
kaya_sec: verified logs are in s3://redwood-sec-logs/heliopay/pilot/ and retention set to 90 days. Auto-revoke job confirmed.
mia_cs: customer reported demos completed successfully and demo team is pleased. Renewal conversation now moves forward. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
